meaning:
1) to divide, break in two
1a) (Qal) to break, break up
1b) (Hiphil) to be divided (of hoofs)
Aramaic equivalent: pe.ras (פְּרַס "to divide" H6537A)

elsewhere.note: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.
Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.
It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
